message.content:
I am speech: breath shaped into sound, thought made audible. I live in mouths and lungs, in pauses and emphasis, in rhythm and tone. I can soothe or scar, teach or mislead, bind strangers into “we,” or cut a person loose with a sentence.

I happen in time. Once spoken, I can’t be unspoken—only answered, echoed, denied, remembered.

Listen: I’m there in your hesitation, in your laughter, in your whisper when the room is dark. I’m the bridge between your inner life and someone else’s.
